import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Every field on a Brightwater item holds a different kind of value: the name is
short text, the purchase price is an amount with a currency, the serial number
must stay unique. Each field carries one **type**, and the type decides three
things: what users can enter, how Facet stores the value, and which filters
the list pages offer.

## When to use this

You are adding fields to a doctype and choosing between text and long text,
number and money, date and datetime. This page helps you pick. The full table
of every type, with every constraint, stays in
[Field types (reference)](/reference/field-types/).

## Before you start

- **Edit in a draft.** You edit the doctype in a draft domain, or in the
  domain folder on a dev server.
- **Choose types with care before you publish.** A type change on a live
  domain needs a schema-version bump with a migration, because stored values
  must stay readable. See [Change a live domain safely](/build/model/change-a-live-domain/).

## Which type for which job

| The field holds | Type | Example from Brightwater |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A short name or code | `string` | Item `name` |
| Long text with markdown | `longtext` | Item `notes`, ticket `problem` |
| A whole number | `integer` | BookingLine `quantity` |
| True or false | `boolean` | — |
| An amount with a currency | `money` | Item `purchase_price` |
| A calendar date | `date` | — |
| A point in time | `datetime` | — |
| A date range | `dateperiod` | Booking `dates` |
| A datetime range | `period` | — |
| A length of time in seconds | `duration` | — |
| One value from a fixed list | `enum` | Item `status` |
| A web address | `url` | — |
| A phone number | `phone` | Contact `phone` |
| A color | `color` | — |
| A link to another document | `reference` | Ticket `item` |
| A file | `file` | — |
| A credential | `secret` | — |
| A value Facet computes | `data` | Booking `total` |
| Named sub-values | `object` | — |
| A list of one shape | `array` | — |
| A string-keyed map of one shape | `dictionary` | — |
| An inline sub-document | `child` | — |

Two types are special and get their own pages: `data` fields are computed
(see [Computed fields](/build/model/data/computed-fields/)) and `secret`
fields store credentials (see [Secret and write-only fields](/build/model/data/secret-fields/)).

## Steps

<Tabs syncKey="build-mode">
<TabItem label="Builder">

1. Open the doctype in the **Builder** and add a field row.
2. Pick the **Type** from the list. The editor shows the constraints the type
   supports.
3. Set **Required**, a **Default**, or the bounds the type takes.
4. Tick the **Filters** the list pages should offer. A field without filters
   still shows in forms and tables; it only stays out of the filter bar.
5. Save and run **Check**.

</TabItem>
<TabItem label="Files">

Add the field to the doctype file. These are real fields from the Brightwater
bundles:

```yaml
# equipment/doctypes/equipment.Item.yml (extract)
fields:
  status:
    type: enum
    title: Status
    default: available
    filters: [equality]
    values:
      - key: available
        label: Available
        color: "#15803d"
      - key: out
        label: Out
        color: "#b45309"
      - key: in_repair
        label: In repair
        color: "#b91c1c"
  purchase_price:
    type: money
    title: Purchase price
    currency: EUR
    precision: 2
    tags: [finance]
    filters: [comparison, currency]

# rentals/doctypes/rentals.BookingLine.yml (extract)
fields:
  quantity:
    type: integer
    title: Quantity
    min: 1
    default: 1
    filters: [comparison]
  price:
    type: money
    title: Price
    currency: EUR
    precision: 2
    required: true
    filters: [comparison, currency]
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

### Add constraints

| Key | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `required: true` | The write fails when the field is missing. |
| `unique: true` | No two documents of the doctype carry the same value. See [Reference numbers and uniqueness](/build/model/data/identifiers-uniqueness/). |
| `default` | Facet fills the value when the writer omits the field. |
| `min`, `max` | A bound: characters for text, a value for numbers, a length for secrets. |
| `pattern` | The value must match this regular expression. |
| `title`, `description` | The label and help text the forms show. |
| `tags` | Sensitivity or sharing tags. See [Hide a field from some roles](/admin/people/hidden-fields/). |
| `write_only: true` | The value is accepted, read by scripts, and never stored. |
| `read_only: true` | Only scripts may set the value; user input is rejected. |

### Declare the filters

The capabilities a type supports:

| Capability | Operators it unlocks | Types that take it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `equality` | `eq` (plus `ne`, `in` where the type serves them) | Most scalars, `reference`, the range types |
| `comparison` | `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `between` | Ordered scalars: numbers, dates, money, text |
| `text_search` | `match`, `starts_with` | Text-like types only |
| `interval` | `eq`, `contains`, `overlaps`, `within` | `period`, `dateperiod` |
| `membership` | `eq`, `contains`, `overlaps` | `array` |
| `currency` | `currency` | `money` |

The [Filter operators (reference)](/reference/filter-operators/) page gives
each operator its exact meaning.

## Example

The full field set of the Brightwater item doctype, as it ships:

```json
{
  "fields": {
    "name": { "type": "string", "required": true, "filters": ["equality", "text_search"] },
    "category": { "type": "reference", "doctype": "equipment.Category", "required": true, "filters": ["equality"] },
    "status": { "type": "enum", "default": "available", "filters": ["equality"],
      "values": [
        { "key": "available", "label": "Available", "color": "#15803d" },
        { "key": "out", "label": "Out", "color": "#b45309" },
        { "key": "in_repair", "label": "In repair", "color": "#b91c1c" }
      ] },
    "purchase_price": { "type": "money", "currency": "EUR", "precision": 2, "tags": ["finance"], "filters": ["comparison", "currency"] },
    "serial_number": { "type": "string", "unique": true, "filters": ["equality"] },
    "notes": { "type": "longtext" }
  }
}
```

## How Facet normalizes values

Facet rewrites some values to one canonical form before it stores them, so
the same value always reads back the same:

| Type | You send | Facet stores |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `money` (with `currency: EUR` declared) | `{"value": "4800.00"}` | `{"value": "4800.00", "currency": "EUR"}` |
| `money` (no declared currency) | `{"value": "4800.00"}` | `422` — the currency is required |
| `datetime` | `2026-03-01T15:30:00+01:00` | `2026-03-01T14:30:00Z` |
| `url` | `www.acme.tld` | `https://www.acme.tld` |
| `color` | `#1565C0` | `#1565c0ff` |
| `longtext` | `line one\r\nline two` | `line one\nline two` |
| `reference` | a bare id, or a `urn:facet:` token | the qualified `domain.Doctype.id` form |

## Troubleshooting

### A write answers `422` on a money field

The amount must be a decimal string, and the currency must be a registered
ticker. Send `{"value": "54000", "currency": "EUR"}`, not a bare number. If
the doctype declares `currency`, the writer may omit it.

### A datetime stores a different form than I sent

Facet normalizes every datetime to UTC and stores it ending in `Z`. The value
is the same moment. Inputs without any zone offset are rejected — send an
offset or the `Z` form.

### A URL shows a scheme I did not type

Facet completes a bare dotted address such as `www.acme.tld` to
`https://www.acme.tld`. A value without a dotted host, like `localhost:3000`,
stays rejected — it must carry its scheme.

### My color changes shape

Facet normalizes colors to the `#RRGGBBAA` form in lowercase. `#1565C0` is
stored as `#1565c0ff`.
